drivekey.question: why
line.water.1: Absolutely not. It's wet out there.
line.water.2: That puddle is looking at me.
line.water.3: If the sky wants to be wet, it can do it without me.
line.box.1: I'm not in the box. This is a coincidence.
line.box.2: Somebody left a perfectly good box. It would be rude not to.
line.sun.1: Five more minutes. The sun is still here.
line.sun.2: The sun has to be sat in. That's what it's for.
line.marti.tea.1: Is there tea? Any tea? Even bad tea.
line.marti.tea.2: I can think after tea. Before tea I can only think about tea.
line.marti.tea.3: The kettle is right there and I am right here. Unacceptable.
line.marti.tea.4: Prasha opens at half seven. It's practically half seven.
line.marti.pockets.light.2: Nothing in my pockets. Anything could happen to me.
line.marti.pockets.heavy.1: Clink. Clink. Clink. Running is out of the question.
line.marti.pockets.heavy.2: I'm carrying the whole shelf again, aren't I.
line.marti.itch.1: Wait. Why is that door painted shut?
line.marti.itch.2: Nobody ever asks where the road crew's road goes.
line.marti.itch.3: Something's glinting out there. Why would anything glint?
line.marti.itch.4: Grandpa would have had a theory about this. Grandpa had a theory about everything.
line.rokko.pillow.1: That is not a pillow. That is a rumour of a pillow.
line.rokko.pillow.3: A dream needs a proper headrest, or it wanders off.
line.rokko.contrary.1: Hold on. Has anyone considered we're all wrong?
line.rokko.contrary.2: Everybody agrees? Then somebody should disagree. Fine. Me.
line.rokko.swoon.1: Oh. Oh no. That is a magnificent… hello.
story.melmans_whistle: Grandpa Melman's tin whistle. He said it was for calling boats, which made no sense, because nobody in Son-Marta-Klekot goes out in boats. He blew it once, the summer it rained for a week, standing in the doorway with his whiskers dripping. Marti never asked who answered.
story.chipped_teacup: The good cup. The chip is on the left so it only cuts you if you drink with the wrong paw, which Marti has never once remembered.
story.odds_jar: A bolt, half a key, three buttons, a seashell nobody can explain, a cork that smells of something festive. Every one of them was a reason not to go somewhere.
story.flea_comb: Fine-toothed and stern. Just looking at it makes your shoulder itch.
obj.old_box: A box he never threw away
story.old_box: It came with the stove. The stove is gone. The box remains, because a box is a promise.
story.kettle: Dented, reliable, slightly more important than the furniture.
story.salvage_shelf: Everything here was going to be thrown away by someone. Marti disagreed with all of them, one object at a time.
story.road_barrier: Striped, stern and very slightly crooked. The crew are proud of it.
story.crate_stack: Cobbles in crates. Every crate looks empty from above, which is a cruel trick to play on a cat.
story.tea_shop_sign: A saucer painted on a board. Someone has painted the chip on very carefully.
story.unclaimed_sock: Striped. Too small for any paw in town. Ogryzok won't say where he got it.
story.laundry_baskets: Grisha's baskets, stacked by size. Technically boxes. Grisha disagrees.
story.rusty_chain: A chain runs from the post into the sand and comes up again further on, as if the beach were sewn together. Somebody tied something to something here, a long time ago.
story.upturned_boat: A boat, belly to the sky. Nobody in town admits to owning it. The paint says a name, but the rain has taken most of the letters.
story.green_bottle: Thick glass, worn smooth. There's no message inside, which somehow makes it worse.
card.something_shiny.name: Something Shiny
card.something_shiny.text: A glint draws a curious cat's attention. On a place or object: curious cats drift toward it.
card.something_shiny.special: Marti blows Melman's whistle. The note goes a long way in a silent town.
card.tea_break.name: Tea Break
card.tea_break.text: Someone, somewhere, puts the kettle on. On a place: everyone nearby downs tools for tea.
card.tea_break.special: Marti makes himself a proper cup. Cozy. Perhaps too cozy.
card.irresistible_junk.name: Irresistible Junk
card.irresistible_junk.text: Marti spots something he can't leave behind.
card.irresistible_junk.special: Marti empties his pockets into the jar. He feels lighter, and slightly exposed.
card.sudden_flea.name: Sudden Flea
card.sudden_flea.text: A cat stops whatever it was doing to deal with an urgent itch.
card.sudden_flea.special: Marti combs until he is calm. Calm enough for almost anything.
card.box.name: Box!
card.box.text: An empty box appears. Nobody can ignore an empty box.
card.box.special: Marti sits in the box. For a while, nothing else matters.
card.empty_teapot.name: Empty Teapot
card.empty_teapot.text: Marti's tea craving, sharpened. On the kettle: there is no tea in the house.
card.wet_paw.name: Wet Paw
card.wet_paw.text: Test card. A cat steps in something wet and remembers it hates water.
card.rumour.name: Rumour
card.rumour.text: Test card. Word spreads that the tea shop is closing early.
card.loud_bang.name: Loud Bang
card.loud_bang.text: Test card. Something falls over with a tremendous noise. Everyone nearby scatters.
power.lure.name: Lure
power.lure.text: A glowing cat appears. Named and unfiltered cats feel the pull to follow it.
power.gaze.name: Gaze
power.gaze.text: Fix a small circle of the world into fact for a few moments. You see what is there, not what you want.
sl.door_lure.at_door: Marti stands at the door with one paw raised, as if the floor had asked him a question.
sl.door_lure.back_inside: He puts the paw down. Back inside. Obviously back inside.
sl.door_lure.out: Marti steps out. The door closes behind him with a sound he will think about later.
sl.roadworks_day.working: The road crew arrives with picks, a barrier and a thermos the size of a small cat.
sl.roadworks_day.on_break: Gavrila declares a tea break. Nobody argues with Gavrila about tea.
sl.roadworks_day.finished: The road is mended. The crew stand back and admire it in silence.
sl.roadworks_day.abandoned: The first drops hit the cobbles. The crew are gone before the second ones land. The trench stays open.
sl.blocked_road.facing: The way to the tea shop is a trench full of rain.
sl.blocked_road.toward_steps: Marti makes for the cobbler's awning. From there, the Sea Steps go down, and something on the sand is glinting.
sl.blocked_road.detour_square: The long way round, then. Through the square. In the rain. For tea.
sl.blocked_road.turn_home: Marti turns for home, very quickly and with great dignity.
sl.keeper_hours.open: Auntie Prasha unbolts the Chipped Saucer and puts out the chalkboard.
sl.keeper_hours.closed_early: Prasha looks at the sky, looks at the empty lane, and turns the sign to CLOSED.
sl.usual_route.shop_open: The Chipped Saucer is warm and smells of bergamot. Prasha pours without asking.
sl.usual_route.settled: Marti settles into the corner seat. The rain can do what it likes now.
sl.usual_route.shop_closed: CLOSED. On a rainy day. Marti stares at the sign as if it had insulted his grandfather.
sl.usual_route.toward_sea: Behind the shop, the slipway runs down toward the sea. Marti has never been down it. He is going down it.
sl.usual_route.go_home: Marti goes home, dripping and betrayed.
sl.chain_on_beach.noticed: A chain comes out of the sand, goes somewhere, and goes back into the sand.
sl.chain_on_beach.following: Marti follows the chain, paw over paw, the way you follow a sentence to find out how it ends.
sl.chain_on_beach.retreat: Too much beach. Too much sea. Marti retreats to the awning to think about the chain from a safe distance.
sl.tideline_wander.wandering: Marti picks his way along the tideline, avoiding every single wave personally.
sl.tideline_wander.found_boat: Past the bottle, past the weed, a boat lies upside down like a sleeping animal.
sl.tideline_wander.under_pier: Marti shelters under the pier stump and listens to the rain drum on it.
sl.rokko_morning.awake: In the attic over the netmaker's, Rokko wakes from a dream that was mostly sea.
sl.rokko_morning.back_to_bed: Rokko decides the dream isn't finished and goes back to it.
sl.rokko_morning.to_beach: Rokko goes down to the beach before anyone is awake to ask him why.
sl.rokko_morning.under_boat: The rain finds Rokko on the beach. He crawls under the old boat, where the sand is almost dry.
sl.rokko_morning.runs_home: Rokko runs for the Sea Steps with his ears flat.
sl.rokko_morning.left: The rain stops. Rokko shakes the sand out of his fur and climbs back up to town.
sl.under_the_boat.hidden: The boat says nothing. The boat is very good at saying nothing.
sl.under_the_boat.tail_spotted: A ginger tail sticks out from under the boat, twitching in its sleep.
sl.under_the_boat.peek_out: A ginger head pokes out from under the boat, blinking at the rain.
sl.under_the_boat.walks_past: Marti walks past. Then slows down. Then stops.
sl.under_the_boat.meeting: Two cats on a beach in the rain, both of them somewhere they shouldn't be.
sl.whistle_blown.blowing: Marti blows Melman's whistle. One thin note goes out over the rooftops and doesn't come back.
sl.marti_cuppa.drinking: The first sip. Everything is fine.
sl.marti_cuppa.cozy: Everything is so fine that going anywhere seems unnecessary.
sl.crew_chatter.tale: Old Semyon, over his tea: "My grandmother said there was a city in the sky, once. Before it fell in the sea."
sl.crew_chatter.overheard: Through the open window, Marti hears every word. A city in the sky. In the sea.
sl.crew_chatter.scoffed: "And my grandmother said tea grows on cats," says Gavrila. Everyone laughs. Everyone agrees.
sl.parcel_drop.dropped: Kuzya delivers a parcel and leaves the box. There is now a box in the street.
sl.laundry_panic.panic: Rain! The sheets! Grisha runs in circles in the laundry yard.
sl.laundry_panic.rescued: The sheets come in damp but saved. Grisha will mention this for weeks.
sl.laundry_panic.soaked_alone: The sheets are soaked. So is Grisha. Nobody came.
sl.pelageya_longing.watching: Pelageya watches the rain with her nose against the glass.
sl.pelageya_longing.window_open: She opens the window. Just a crack. Just to hear it.
sl.pelageya_longing.paw_out: Pelageya puts one paw out into the rain, and holds it there, and doesn't know why.
sl.pelageya_longing.shut: The window shuts. She wipes her paw on the curtain and doesn't look at it.
sl.ogryzok_trade.sizing_up: Ogryzok looks Marti up and down, mostly down, mostly at his pockets.
sl.ogryzok_trade.offers: "Got a thing," says Ogryzok. "Swap you for a thing."
sl.ogryzok_trade.traded: Marti comes away with a striped sock and the feeling he's been told a secret.
sl.ogryzok_trade.refused: "Suit yourself," says Ogryzok, and the thing goes back into wherever things go.
anchor.meeting.name: Under the boat
anchor.meeting.teaser: Rain on a beach. An upturned boat. Two cats who should both be at home.
ui.end.locked_rokko: Rokko's morning is a thread of its own. It isn't ready to be followed yet.
ui.hint.inspect: Look closer at things in the flat. Each one remembers something.
ui.hint.scroll: Drag the timeline back. Nothing you haven't seen is settled yet.
ui.hint.fray: From here on, the meeting can't happen. Something earlier has to change.
